facts: Current server reserves the foreground account for a tool-producing Sol round before TurnAffinityStore.put and before ConversationSegmentStore.put.
Current ConversationSegmentStore._save_locked swallows NCM28 write failure by setting persistence_blocked, so current code can still return a tool call after durable publication failed.
V7 requires durable publication to become fail-closed; once that is enforced, keeping reservation-before-commit creates a ghost reservation for a tool call that was never published to Codex.
TurnAffinityStore is memory-only and is currently populated before durable conversation state, so it also must not be populated before the durable replay record commits.
The rendered Responses payload is currently created only after both stores are mutated, so exact response_id/item_id/call_id cannot be included in the durable transaction without reordering.
required_ordering_v8: render canonical Responses payload once, including response_id/item_id/call_id
atomically publish conversation progress plus rendered replay record; failure must be observable to caller
only after durable success: update memory-only TurnAffinityStore
only after durable success: reserve/clear foreground account according to the canonical rendered item
only after durable success: emit any identity-bearing HTTP/SSE response
failure_invariant: If durable publication fails, no tool call, no response/call identifiers, no affinity cache entry and no foreground reservation may become externally or internally authoritative for that request.
scope_boundary: No rotation, prompt-mode, delegation or account/thread-affinity policy is redesigned; this is only Core crash/lifecycle ordering at the integration boundary.
